chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from al-Sindi ibn Muhammad, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from Aslam al-Makki, the narrator of 'Amir ibn Wa'il, said:

I asked him, 'How many times did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) perform Hajj?' He said, 'Ten. Do you not hear [that] the Farewell Pilgrimage was not the first, for he had performed Hajj before that?'
ai.seo_question: How many times did the Prophet Muhammad perform Hajj according to Shia hadith sources?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* confirms the total number of the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) Hajjs as ten, a figure widely accepted in Shia and Sunni scholarship. It clarifies that the celebrated 'Farewell Hajj' was the culmination of a series of pilgrimages, emphasizing the Prophet's consistent adherence to the ritual from the early Medinan period until his final journey.
